note: Real. Scored by analysis/statistics/checks.py against the written rules in research/predictions.md.

checks.name: Aqua's look time over each Brazilian biome rises every year 2021-2025; VIIRS stays flat
checks.detail: Reading (a) 2022-2025 each >= prior year: 6/6 biomes. Reading (b) also 2021 >= 2020: 3/6 (amazon 2021 vs 2020: -0.7 min; cerrado 2021 vs 2020: -0.8 min; pantanal 2021 vs 2020: -0.8 min). S-NPP within 10 min of 2012-2020 every year: 6/6. Readings disagree: the team must pick one in research/predictions.md before this is scored.

checks.name: Punjab Aqua look time follows Jethva 2026 (1:44 PM in 2021 to 3:12 PM in 2025)
checks.detail: Aqua later every year 2021-2025: yes; total rise 76 min (rule 60-120). Our absolute times run 27-39 min earlier than Jethva's; time convention not yet checked.

checks.name: Our FIRMS Aqua data reproduces INPE's reference counts
checks.detail: Biome-months 2012-2020 within 10% of INPE: 96.9% with all daytime Aqua detections, 78.2% with the plan's filters (type 0, confidence >= 30). Rule: >= 90%. Note: P3 was computed before the predictions were committed (see the honest timeline).

checks.name: Day-to-day sampling noise explains the pre-drift wobble
checks.detail: Placebo years (2012-2020, each held out) whose 95% block-bootstrap interval contains 1: amazon 7/9, cerrado 9/9, caatinga 8/9, mata_atlantica 8/9, pantanal 7/9, pampa 8/9. Rule: >= 7/9. Detection rule used: L outside the placebo range.

checks.name: Fire-size mix doesn't explain the audit
checks.detail: L_strat (days split into S-NPP mean-FRP terciles, reweighted to the 2012-2020 mix) inside L's 95% interval in 28/29 biome-years 2021-2025. Largest move: 0.089. Day-level classes (the daily file has no per-detection FRP).

checks.name: VIIRS is a stable clock
checks.detail: L with S-NPP as reference inside L with NOAA-20's 95% interval in 30/30 biome-years 2021-2025 (both baselines 2018-2020; identical Aqua/Terra/S-NPP/NOAA-20 observed-day support). Largest gap: 0.123.

checks.name: Closure: the timing slope predicts the observed L
checks.detail: L_pred inside the 90% interval of L in 16/23 strict biome-years (70%; rule >= 75%). beta = log(Aqua/Terra) per hour of look-time gap, 2012-2020 (same MODIS sensor, same days). Misses: amazon 2023 (pred 1.12, obs 1.02), amazon 2024 (pred 1.29, obs 1.10), cerrado 2024 (pred 1.10, obs 1.18), caatinga 2024 (pred 1.21, obs 1.47), mata_atlantica 2021 (pred 1.01, obs 1.05), mata_atlantica 2023 (pred 1.10, obs 1.02), pantanal 2024 (pred 1.10, obs 0.97).

checks.name: VIIRS detects small real fires better than MODIS
checks.detail: a50 (fire size detected half the time), 2012-2020: S-NPP 319 acres [271.0, 375.1], Aqua 946 acres [777.2, 1168.0]. Not pre-registered (computed before the commit).

checks.name: Opposite drifts move the Terra and Aqua probes in opposite directions
checks.detail: Written VIIRS-pair gate not identifiable from these aggregates; not scored. Exploratory MODIS proxy supports 4/6 biomes: amazon A up, T down; cerrado A up, T down; caatinga A up, T down; mata_atlantica A up, T down; pantanal A not monotone, T not monotone; pampa A up, T not monotone. The original proxy failed its all-biomes criterion. MODIS Terra/Aqua beta is not the written VIIRS same-day-pair gate and does not validate P9.

checks.name: The two-clock difference agrees with the audit
checks.detail: Clock share of log A_y = clock_diff x dA/(dA - dT) inside the 95% interval of log L_y in 15/23 biome-years 2022-2025 (65%; rule >= 75%). Misses: amazon 2025, cerrado 2025, caatinga 2024, mata_atlantica 2024, pantanal 2023, pantanal 2024, pampa 2023, pampa 2025.
